title: Plan Review Prep Pack
blurb: Seven pages that get you from "the letter came" to walking in ready. Evidence checklist, the three questions planners actually ask, and a script for the hard bit.

title: My NDIS Goals Workbook
blurb: Goals written the way the system funds them, in words that are still yours. Worked examples for kids, adults and people who hate writing goals.

title: Support at Home: the first 90 days
blurb: What happens after the assessment, who calls whom, and what you can push back on. For the adult child doing this from two suburbs away.

title: The GP appointment, scripted
blurb: A plain-English script for asking your GP for mental health support, for you or the person you care for. What to say, what to ask, and what happens next.
